decisions.decision: Keep exactly one browser offline runtime backend: the WASM GGUF adapter (wllama).
decisions.reason: The stored model is a GGUF in OPFS. An MLC/WebGPU backend needs a second, differently compiled model, which would break install-once reuse and create a second model authority.

decisions.decision: src/lib/commercial is the single account-wide usage/entitlement authority; src/lib/limits stays only as the request rate limiter.
decisions.reason: They answer different questions. The allowance (28 uses per 388 minutes) is commercial; burst/abuse limiting is limits.

decisions.decision: Supabase rows are the only conversation/message authority; no device vault, no incognito branch.
decisions.reason: docs/RULES.md rule 8 and the existing store's own conclusion.
